# Studio V2 Frontend-to-Backend API Traceability

<!-- Generated by backend/scripts/generate_studio_v2_frontend_traceability.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This artifact extracts API calls from Studio pages, Studio V2 components, and Studio hooks with the TypeScript compiler AST, then matches them against the live FastAPI router. Tests, spec files, and `__tests__` directories are excluded. Dynamic paths are expanded when their finite values are visible in the source, and remaining template segments are matched to one unambiguous backend path parameter. Hook call sites are traced through their imports to every in-scope component or page that invokes the hook. The extractor rejects any in-scope `/api/v2/` path expression it cannot classify as a request, so unsupported client call patterns fail the drift check instead of silently disappearing from this table.

An unreferenced backend route is inventory information and is not automatically a defect.
